blocks.text: Kai qisam ke saboot evolution ki taeed karte hain. Yeh hissa biogeography, comparative anatomy aur molecular biology ke saboot dekhta hai.

items: Comparative anatomy: homologous, analogous aur vestigial dhaanche.
Molecular biology: mutaliq jandaron mein milta julta DNA aur proteins.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse mein evolution ke saboot ki teen qismein batayein.
blocks.explanation: Biogeography, comparative anatomy aur molecular biology.

items: Saboot: biogeography, comparative anatomy, molecular biology.
